description: Searches public X Posts from the last 7 days using X search syntax (keywords, phrases, hashtags, cashtags, or operators such as from:handle). Returns engagement, views and direct links; sorted by relevance unless latest=true. Results are capped at 10 Posts.

latest.description: Return the newest Posts instead of top relevance. Defaults to false.

limit.description: Max Posts to return (1-10). Defaults to 5.

minLikes.description: Only Posts with at least this many likes. Defaults to 0.

query.description: X recent-search query (keywords, phrases, hashtags, cashtags, or operators), e.g. "$BTC", "bitcoin ETF", or "from:handle BTC". Self-serve query limit: 512 characters.

name: sentiment_twitter
title: Twitter Sentiment
